notes.title: Over The Phone Will Be Free To Play Soon
notes.content:
It's been roughly 6 months since the release of Over The Phone.  The general response to the game or lack thereof is reasonable.  I did no marketing for it, and it's not a very marketable game to begin with.  But I plan on taking that side of things more seriously with future projects. 

It's also just not the best example of what I'm capable of.  I set out to make a simple game with the hopes of making enough from sales that I could work full time on a more serious project.  If I can't do that, it might as well be free, and whenever Steam approves, maybe in the next week or so, it will become free to play.

Thanks to everyone who did purchase and supported me.  Anyone who purchased recently should be able to get a refund if you like; contact Steam to do so.

- Paul
